gloss: sunlight filtering through trees; dappled sunlight

definitions.gloss: sunlight filtering through trees; dappled sunlight
definitions.explanation: The beautiful effect of sunlight streaming through gaps in tree leaves, creating patterns of light and shadow on the ground.

examples.japanese: {木漏|こも}れ{日|び}が{差|さ}し{込|こ}む。
{森|もり}の{中|なか}で{木漏|こも}れ{日|び}を{浴|あ}びた。
examples.english: I bathed in the sunlight filtering through the trees in the forest.

examples.japanese: {木漏|こも}れ{日|び}の{美|うつく}しさに{心|こころ}が{癒|いや}される。
examples.english: The beauty of the dappled sunlight soothes my heart.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{木|こ} (tree) + {漏|も}れ (to leak through) + {日|び} (sunlight) - literally "sunlight leaking through trees"

CULTURAL NOTE:
This is considered one of Japan's beautiful untranslatable words, representing the Japanese appreciation for subtle natural phenomena. It's often cited as an example of the Japanese aesthetic sensitivity to nature.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {木漏|こも}れ{日|び}が{差|さ}す - sunlight filters through
- {木漏|こも}れ{日|び}を{浴|あ}びる - to bathe in dappled sunlight
